# v0.6.1 - Object-Format Protocol Compliance, Fail-Closed Remote GC & Architectural Wiring

## What's Changed in v0.6.1

### Protocol Compliance & Concurrency Hardening
- **Git Remote Helper Object-Format Protocol Negotiation (N-1)**: Advertised `option` + `object-format` capabilities in `helper.py`, replied `ok` to `option object-format true`, and emitted `:object-format <algorithm>` during `cmd_list` by detecting hash length on remote refs. Enables native Git push and clone of SHA-256 repositories without pack corruption errors.
- **Fail-Closed Remote GC Compaction (N-2, N-3)**: In `gc.py:compact_repository`, made remote pack download fail-closed (aborts compaction immediately on network errors or size mismatch) and restricted Step 7 pack deletion exclusively to successfully compacted packs. Enforced 16MB ceiling on in-memory download buffers.
- **Git LFS Custom Transfer Agent Progress Delta (N-4)**: In `lfs.py`, tracked `last_bytes` per transfer and emitted incremental `bytesSinceLast` in `progress` events rather than total file size, restoring accurate Git LFS throughput rates and ETAs.
- **Push Lock Ownership Fencing (N-14)**: Enforced `lock.verify_ownership()` immediately before writing remote ref files in `cmd_push` to prevent split-brain pushes if lease renewal failed during large pack uploads.
- **Ref Name Validation Conformance (N-12)**: Permitted legal `@` characters in ref names per `git check-ref-format` (e.g. `feature@v2`) while rejecting standalone `@` components and `@{` reflog sequences.
- **Safety Typo Error Preservation (N-13)**: In `safety.py`, gated typo suggestion queries strictly on 404 / not-found errors, preserving genuine API errors (HTTP 500, timeouts, duplicate libraries) rather than misleadingly reporting "Library not found".

### Robustness & Performance Optimizations
- **Windows CLI Stdio Normalization across All Subcommands (N-5)**: Reconfigured `sys.stdout` (UTF-8, LF) and `sys.stdin` (UTF-8) unconditionally at the start of `cli.py:main`, ensuring `lfs-transfer` operates reliably on Windows without `UnicodeEncodeError` or CRLF corruption.
- **Case-Insensitive URL Scheme & URL Parsing Hardening (N-15, N-17)**: Handled case-insensitive `seafile://` schemes and rejected empty hosts in explicit URLs (`seafile://https:///lib/repo`).
- **Upload File String Content Safety (N-16)**: Strictly encoded `str` content to UTF-8 without querying local filesystem paths.
- **LFS Scratch Storage Co-location (N-8)**: Placed LFS temporary scratch directory under `.git/lfs/tmp` when available, eliminating cross-volume moves on multi-drive setups.
- **Packfile Install Atomic Move Optimization (N-7)**: Supported `move=True` in `install_packfile` and `fetch_and_install_pack` to move staged packfiles into staging atomically with `shutil.move` / `os.replace`, eliminating redundant disk copies.
- **SQLite Safe Reading Consolidation (N-9)**: Reused `_copy_with_sidecars` and `_SIDECAR_SUFFIXES` from `sqlite_read.py` in `tools/seafile_doctor.py`.
